description:
src/cache.rs:477-501: is_rollback and crl_number_gt have opposite semantic polarity — is_rollback returns true when the new entry is OLDER, crl_number_gt returns true when the incoming is NEWER. Reading the call site:

    if is_rollback(self.cache.get_crl(&key).as_deref(), meta.crl_number.as_deref()) { return; }

requires the reader to keep both inversions in head. is_rollback is the right verb for the caller's intent — flagging this as opinion only because the alternative (single comparator + clear ordering at the call site) sacrifices readability of the call site for symmetry of the helpers.

Skip if disagreeing. Marked opinion.
title: is_rollback / crl_number_gt naming: both functions; one returns 'is this a rollback' the other 'is incoming greater'
